body:
Confirmed that `no-global-assign` appears in `conf/eslint-recommended.js` but the rule's `meta.docs.recommended` is set to `false`.

I assume that `no-global-assign` should in fact be recommended, so the fix here would be to set `meta.docs.recommended` to `true`, and then the docs will update themselves in the next release.
This would be a good first bug for new contributors!

    The func-name-matching rule checks for assignments to function expressions so that it can determine whether names match. However, due to a missing type-check, the rule would crash when run on a destructuring assignment to a function expression. This commit updates the rule to ignore destructuring assignments to function expressions.

issue.title: The eslint:recommended status of rules is stored in two different places

labels.name: archived due to age
labels.description: This issue has been archived; please open a new issue for any further discussion

repository.name: eslint
repository.description: Find and fix problems in your JavaScript code.

issue.body:
Currently, we store the eslint:recommended status of rules in [eslint-recommended.json](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/02f0d272f4d4d6bdc944e0ead9327efdda0cee11/conf/eslint-recommended.js), but each rule also has a [`meta.recommended` property](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/02f0d272f4d4d6bdc944e0ead9327efdda0cee11/lib/rules/no-cond-assign.js#L25). I think `eslint-recommended.json` is used to create the `eslint:recommended` config at runtime, whereas `meta.recommended` is used to generate the docs.

This is a bit confusing -- the information is duplicated, and the effects of changing a flag in either file aren't immediately clear. It has also caused some problems in practice. One rule was out of sync for awhile between the actual behavior and the docs before being fixed in https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/8215. Another rule [still](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/02f0d272f4d4d6bdc944e0ead9327efdda0cee11/conf/eslint-recommended.js#L196) [is](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/blob/02f0d272f4d4d6bdc944e0ead9327efdda0cee11/lib/rules/no-unsafe-negation.js#L47) out of sync. Two rules were added to `eslint:recommended` in a chore PR [here](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/pull/7467), which probably should have been a breaking change.

We should combine the two sources of information here to avoid confusion and unexpected errors.
